name: galaris-desktop
description: Desktop client for a self-hosted Galaris server
author: Galaris contributors

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --external:electron-updater --outfile=dist-main/main.cjs && esbuild src/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-main/preload.cjs && node scripts/notices.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --publish never
scripts.pack: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --dir --publish never
